q.t: A fair coin is tossed. Find P(head).
q.e: 2 equally likely outcomes, 1 of them a head.

q.t: A die is thrown. Find P(a number greater than 4).
q.e: Only 5 and 6 are greater than 4: 2 out of 6.

q.t: Find P(E) + P(not E).
q.e: Either E happens or it doesn’t — together they cover every outcome.

q.t: What is the probability of an impossible event?
q.e: No outcome is favourable, so 0 out of n.

q.t: A card is drawn from a pack of 52. Find P(red card).
q.e: 26 of the 52 cards are red (hearts and diamonds).

q.t: P(E) = 0.35. Find P(not E).
q.e: P(not E) = 1 − P(E).

q.t: Which of these can NOT be a probability?
q.e: Favourable outcomes can never be more than all outcomes, so a probability is never above 1.

q.t: A bag has 3 red and 5 black balls. One is drawn. Find P(red).
q.e: 3 favourable out of 8.

q.t: A card is drawn from a pack of 52. Find P(king).
q.e: There are 4 kings: 4/52.

q.t: A die is thrown. Find P(prime number).
q.e: 2, 3 and 5 are prime (1 is not): 3 out of 6.

q.t: Two coins are tossed. Find P(at least one head).
q.e: Outcomes HH, HT, TH, TT. Only TT has no head, so 3 of 4.

q.t: Two dice are thrown. Find P(sum = 8).
q.e: (2,6), (3,5), (4,4), (5,3), (6,2): 5 of the 36 equally likely pairs.

q.t: A number is chosen from 1 to 30. Find P(it is a multiple of 4).
q.e: 4, 8, …, 28 — that is 7 numbers.

q.t: A card is drawn from a pack of 52. Find P(face card).
q.e: J, Q, K in 4 suits: 12 cards. 12/52 = 3/13.

q.t: Find the probability that a leap year has 53 Sundays.
q.e: 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 days. Those 2 extra days are one of 7 equally likely pairs, and 2 of the pairs contain a Sunday.

q.t: A bag has 5 red, 8 white and 7 green balls. Find P(not green).
q.e: 13 non-green out of 20.

q.t: Two dice are thrown. Find P(both show the same number).
q.e: 6 doublets out of 36.

q.t: Three coins are tossed. Find P(exactly two heads).
q.e: 8 outcomes; HHT, HTH, THH have exactly two heads.

q.t: A card is drawn from a pack of 52. Find P(neither a king nor a queen).
q.e: 8 kings and queens, so 44 cards are neither: 44/52.

q.t: A box has discs numbered 1 to 100. One is drawn. Find P(perfect square).
Two dice are thrown. Find P(product = 6).
Two dice are thrown. Find P(sum is prime).
q.e: Sums 2, 3, 5, 7, 11 come up 1 + 2 + 4 + 6 + 2 = 15 ways out of 36.

q.t: A bag holds 15 balls, x of them white. If 5 more white balls are added, P(white) doubles. Find x.
A bag has red, blue and green balls. P(red) = 1/4, P(blue) = 1/3, and there are 10 green balls. How many balls are there?
q.e: P(green) = 1 − 1/4 − 1/3 = 5/12, and 5/12 of the total is 10.

q.t: A card is drawn from a pack of 52. Find P(red face card).
q.e: J, Q, K of hearts and diamonds: 6 cards. 6/52 = 3/26.

q.t: A number is chosen from 1 to 50. Find P(divisible by 3 or 5).
q.e: 16 multiples of 3 and 10 of 5, but 3 (15, 30, 45) are counted twice: 23 numbers.

q.t: A die is thrown twice. Find P(at least one 6).
q.e: P(no 6) = 25/36, so P(at least one) = 11/36.

q.t: A two-digit number is made from two different digits of 1, 2, 3. Find P(it is even).
q.e: The 6 numbers are 12, 13, 21, 23, 31, 32. Even ones end in 2: 12 and 32.

q.t: A batch of 200 bulbs has 16 faulty ones. One bulb is picked. Find P(it works).
q.e: 184 good bulbs out of 200.

q.t: A coin is tossed three times. Find P(at most one head).
q.e: TTT, HTT, THT, TTH: 4 of 8.

q.t: Two dice are thrown. Find P(the numbers differ by 1).
Two dice are thrown. Find P(sum is at least 10).
q.e: Sum 10: 3 ways, 11: 2 ways, 12: 1 way. 6 of 36.

q.t: Cards numbered 2 to 101 are in a box. One is drawn. Find P(perfect square).
q.e: 100 cards. The squares are 4, 9, …, 100 (2² to 10²): 9 of them.

q.t: All red face cards are removed from a pack of 52. One card is drawn from the rest. Find P(king).
q.e: 6 cards go, leaving 46, and only the 2 black kings remain.

q.t: x is picked from 1, 2, 3 and y from 1, 4, 9. Find P(xy < 9).
q.e: 9 pairs. Products below 9: 1, 4, 2, 8, 3 — that is 5.

q.t: A coin is tossed four times. Find P(exactly two heads).
q.e: 16 outcomes; choose which 2 tosses are heads: 6 ways.

q.t: A box has 5 red, 8 white and 4 green marbles. A white one is taken out and not put back. Find P(white) for the next draw.
q.e: Now 7 white out of 16.

q.t: A die has faces 0, 1, 1, 1, 6, 6. It is thrown twice. Find P(total = 7).
q.e: Total 7 needs a 1 and a 6: 1 then 6 is 3 × 2 = 6 ways, 6 then 1 is 6 ways. 12 of 36.

q.t: Two dice are thrown. Find P(the product is a perfect square).
q.e: The 6 doublets, plus (1,4) and (4,1): 8 of 36.

q.t: A number is chosen from 1 to 100. Find P(divisible by neither 2 nor 3).
q.e: Divisible by 2 or 3: 50 + 33 − 16 = 67. That leaves 33.
